text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp began once again 
this year. Since it was her second time, 
Yukino Bijin seemed used to it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I carried the luggage over ahead of time! 
Let's start training right away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup at 
my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gotta do everything we can before the 
race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Furrrst, what should we start with—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Miss City is acting a little strange 
after all, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Victoria Mile, I had 
occasionally caught Gold City sighing to 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"People are already talking about me this 
much... and it's not even about my 
running, but my looks."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way she doesn't care at all, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Even so! It's not like there's anything 
I could do for City-san, though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! After all, City-san is 
totally amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"She's strong, true to herself, cool... 
She's just perfect. It'd be presumptuous 
of me to even say anything."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list:
I wonder if there's really anyone who's 
completely perfect in every way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you looked like such an amazin' 
big-city Umamusume... but turns out, 
nobody's completely perfect.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list:
If you get the chance, you should try 
talking to them.
